messages:
alex: quick sync — PR #61299 is ready for merge but needs runtime + security sign-off. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/61299
jordan: looked at changes yesterday, main risk is kv-cache migration. runtime should confirm perf tests. @sasha can you take a perf pass? :eyes:
sasha: on it — will run local perf profile and smoke tests by EOD. did you run canary?
alex: yes did a 1% canary for 30m — no errors, slight latency bump ~3ms. logs attached.
indra: tagging infra for deploy infra protobuf changes. @maria any infra concerns?
maria: infra ok w/ config but need migration window (low traffic) and k8s drain plan. prefer weekend cutover.
alex: understood — looking for runtime + sec thumbs. @security can we get quick eyes on auth header reorder? it's a small change but touches authn flow.
sec-bot: Auto-scan: no high-severity findings. (dependency check cleared)
jordan: if runtime + security ok, propose merge Tuesday 10:00 PT. canary -> scale to 10% then full.
sasha: +1 on perf, will post microbench results here when done.
maria: +1 infra, will reserve maintenance window Tues 09:30-11:00 PT.
security: quick note: need a short blurb in the deploy runbook about rollback and who'll own key rotation; otherwise OK.
alex: perfect — merging plan: wait for sasha perf artifacts and security blurb. TY everyone :thumbsup:
